data.st-eve-2107-tour-001|description: Yu appears where SUNNY PEACE is practicing, and they get excited talking about outdoor lives. Just then Sakura shows up and brings the news that SUNNY PEACE will be appearing at a live event to be held in Okinawa.
data.st-eve-2107-tour-002|description: The members of SUNNY PEACE are thrilled about the work in Okinawa and chatting happily. But amid it all, Haruko alone wears a gloomy face. Asked why she's so down, she begins to tell of her past experiences—.
data.st-eve-2107-tour-003|description: After arriving in Okinawa, the SUNNY PEACE members meet up with Yu, who had arrived earlier, and head to the hotel. Then it suddenly starts to rain, and Haruko ends up depressed, once again blaming her own bad luck. Unable to watch, the others try to cheer Haruko up, but...
data.st-eve-2107-tour-004|description: The SUNNY PEACE members visit Yu's villa to rehearse for the live. Drawn along by the others, who get excited at the lavish interior, Haruko also regains her smile. And after practice, Sakura notices something—.
data.st-eve-2107-tour-005|description: Under clear skies, the SUNNY PEACE group finishes the live to great success. That night they enjoy a barbecue at the after-party and have a wonderful time. Amid it all, Haruko, now alone with Yu, begins to speak of what's in her heart.
data.st-eve-2108-tour-001|description: The morning after the live. Mei tells the group that Tsuki no Tempest has received an offer to appear at a festival held in Fukuoka. The group is fired up with motivation, but upon learning that Tsuki no Tempest has been busy lately and might have to turn the offer down...
data.st-eve-2108-tour-002|description: The Tsuki no Tempest group keeps practicing for the festival. Meanwhile, Mei seems absent-minded. Before the worried members who press her for answers, Mei begins to voice her concerns about appearing at the festival.
data.st-eve-2108-tour-003|description: At Mei's suggestion, the members head to the sea, saying that to grasp the image of a summer-like new song they need to experience summer firsthand. They're fully enjoying summer, but as work on the new song drags on, signs of impatience begin to show in Kotono...
data.st-eve-2108-tour-003|name: A Summer Worthy of Tsuki no Tempest
data.st-eve-2108-tour-004|description: With progress on the new song not going well, they decide to go to a fireworks festival starting in the evening. Inspiration for the new song wells up from the fireworks festival jinx whispered about around town, and the new song's theme takes shape. What is this bold theme?
data.st-eve-2108-tour-005|description: The summer festival finally begins. The new song, depicting a summer romance, was finished at the very last minute after much struggle. Will the new song, expressing 'a summer worthy of Tsuki no Tempest,' reach the fans' hearts—.
data.st-eve-2109-backside-001|description: Amid the fans' frenzy at the live, Ai herself is greatly excited. But the next day, Rio throws harsh words at her. Unable to sort out her feelings, she attends a meeting, and Rio's proposal there is unexpected.
data.st-eve-2109-backside-002|description: Ai just can't focus on practicing a song important both to herself and to LizNoir. Unable to watch Ai stay stuck in her heart's confusion, Kokoro proposes a lesson training camp.
data.st-eve-2109-backside-003|description: The training camp begins at Suzu's villa. Suzu and Kokoro try to repair Ai's strained relationship with Rio, one cause of Ai's inability to concentrate. But things don't go so smoothly...
data.st-eve-2109-backside-004|description: With Kokoro and the others' plan, they lure Rio out to a pancake shop she loves, and Ai finally gets to talk directly with Rio, just the two of them. How will Rio respond to Ai's words, spoken with gathered courage—.
data.st-eve-2109-backside-005|description: With the awkwardness gone, Ai throws her straightforward feelings at Rio—to take 'The Last Chance,' a song she's attached to, and the reborn four-member LizNoir to even greater heights—.
data.st-eve-2110-marathon-001|description: The eve of Mana's birthday—the first since Hoshimi Production expanded to Tokyo. You reunite with Mana in a dream, and Kotono looks back on Mana's birthday in days gone by. Each holds their feelings for Mana as they welcome that moment.
data.st-eve-2110-marathon-002|description: With TRINITYAiLE and LizNoir also rushing over, all of Hoshimi Production works together to prepare Mana's birthday party, but the person who understood Mana best was nowhere to be seen. Leaving a message saying 'I'm going to Hoshimi City'—.
data.st-eve-2110-marathon-003|description: Mana is no longer here—. But the feelings toward Mana naturally guided your feet to the land of memories. And Sakura appears to come pick you up, as if she knew the place. As if guided—.
data.st-eve-2110-marathon-004|description: The members of Hoshimi Production set up an impromptu Mana birthday live with their own hands. Kokoro couldn't help but find it mysterious—'Nagase Mana,' the presence that drives such a distinguished lineup of members this far...
data.st-eve-2110-marathon-005|description: The impromptu birthday live begins. The Hoshimi Production members perform Mana's songs perfectly. For some reason, people gather one after another at a live that shouldn't have been announced. And finally, that song echoes through the packed venue—.
data.st-eve-2110-marathon-006|description: An after-party that doubles as Mana's birthday party. After a while, the members fall asleep from exhaustion. Amid this, Sakura and Kokoro wake up. In the little time left of Mana's birthday... there were three figures talking together.
data.st-eve-2111-backside-001|description: While devoting themselves to hard training, an offer for a dance-centered festival comes in, and Mei and Rei are chosen as a new unit. Their idol activities seem to be going smoothly, but Rei had a weight on her heart...
data.st-eve-2111-backside-002|description: The cause of the weight on Rei's heart was the awkwardness with her parents. Given the history between them, Rei shows resignation about repairing the relationship. Thinking of Rei, Mei and Suzu take bold action to resolve the parent-child problem, but...
data.st-eve-2111-backside-003|description: Mei and Suzu tell Rei that they negotiated directly with her parents to come to the live, but Rei's distrust of her parents does not change. To the stubborn Rei, Mei and Suzu convey the feelings entrusted to them by her mother.
data.st-eve-2111-backside-004|description: The day of the live for Rei and Mei's new unit. By then, Rei had met with her father and given him a ticket. But as expected, their feelings did not meet in their talk... Will Rei's parents show up at the venue?
data.st-eve-2111-backside-005|description: Rei takes on the live with all her might, as if to embody her feelings for the work of an idol, on which she has staked her life. In response, Mei also gives a superb performance. Will Rei's feelings reach her parents—.
data.st-eve-2112-marathon-001|description: Though activities were going smoothly, the three members of TRINITYAiLE were able to spend a calm Christmas season, unlike the extremely busy Banpuro era. There, Sumire hits upon an idea.
data.st-eve-2112-marathon-002|description: Sumire was planning a surprise Christmas party for the three members. To let them enjoy it even a little, she practices making a cake, but it doesn't go well. Then Rui and Yu appear...
data.st-eve-2112-marathon-003|description: TRINITYAiLE suddenly gets work on Christmas Eve. Sumire, who had been steadily preparing for the Christmas party, can't hide her dismay. Unable to switch gears, she can't concentrate on lessons.
data.st-eve-2112-marathon-004|description: The Christmas live begins. Both the costumes and the performance turn out wonderfully, achieving great success. Though they couldn't have a party, Sumire tries at least to give presents to Rui and Yu, but—.
data.st-eve-2112-marathon-005|description: Returning to the dorm, Sumire felt a deep loneliness at spending Christmas all alone, but there were Rui and Yu, who should have been away for work. From an unexpected reverse surprise, a Christmas party begins with just the three of them.
data.st-eve-2201-contest-001|description: At year's end, Sakura and the other SUNNY PEACE members talk over the memories of the past year. It was decided that they would appear at a big event on New Year's Eve, the culmination of the year. And on the day of the event, the members' tension reaches its peak, but—.
data.st-eve-2201-contest-002|description: With the push of the fans' cheers, SUNNY PEACE makes the countdown live a success. The exhausted members fall asleep before they know it, and wake up at an awkward time before dawn. There, Sakura makes a suggestion.
data.st-eve-2201-contest-003|description: Sakura and the others head to the land of memories by special train to see the first sunrise. The five who arrive safely witness the glorious first sunrise and renew their resolve. After that, the New Year's holiday continues with just the five of them—.
data.st-eve-2201-contest-004|description: At Sakura's suggestion, the members visit Sakura's family home. And while gathered around the osechi, they tell her parents their feelings about Sakura. After a wonderful New Year, an unexpected situation arises as they return to Tokyo for work—.
data.st-eve-2201-contest-005|description: The unthinkable: the return train is suspended. With other means of transport also difficult, the five face the worst-case scenario of not making it in time for their first live of the year. Then Sakura gets a phone call—.
data.st-eve-2201-contest-005|name:
Like the Sun
of the First Sunrise
data.st-eve-2202-marathon-001|description: After LizNoir's live, Kokoro and Ai praise each other for a fulfilling performance. Kokoro heads to the dressing room to invite Rio and Aoi to the after-party. There, Kokoro happens to overhear a shocking truth...
data.st-eve-2202-marathon-002|description: Kokoro begins researching to plan a 'Valentine song worthy of LizNoir,' showing extraordinary effort. And Ai, seeing Kokoro act differently than usual, offers to help.
data.st-eve-2202-marathon-003|description: The proposal Kokoro put together doesn't get a nod from Rio and Aoi... but Kokoro never gave up. She pleaded with the two to let her make the proposal again—.
data.st-eve-2202-marathon-004|description: For several days, Kokoro shuts herself in her room. To the worried Ai, Rio and Aoi tell her what happened at the NEXT VENUS Grand Prix, and that Kokoro may be feeling responsible.
data.st-eve-2202-marathon-005|description: Touched by Ai's feelings, Kokoro recovers. Together they rework the plan once more and finally complete the 'Valentine song worthy of LizNoir.' Carrying this wonderful song, the four head to the live.
data.st-eve-2203-race-001|description: Shizuku is overwhelmed by TRINITYAiLE's lessons, especially Rui's, which are full of spirit. Having begun lessons, Shizuku receives guidance from Rui and remains constantly diffident. Then Shizuku is suddenly summoned by you and receives a surprising proposal.
data.st-eve-2203-race-002|description: Shizuku receives an unexpected proposal for a solo debut, but humbly says it's too difficult for her. However, Rui sensed talent in her singing voice. The next day, TRINITYAiLE rises up to support Shizuku's solo debut.
data.st-eve-2203-race-003|description: Even with TRINITYAiLE pushing her forward, Shizuku can't gain confidence. Finding her extremely low self-esteem questionable, Rui asks Shizuku about her past. Touched by Shizuku's feelings, Rui gives up on her solo debut, but receives a certain proposal from Shizuku.
data.st-eve-2203-race-004|description: Shizuku and Rui end up forming an impromptu unit. But getting to that point involved a conflict for Rui, who takes pride in performing as TRINITYAiLE. This time, with Yu and Sumire's encouragement, they finally begin lessons, but the outlook grows ominous...
data.st-eve-2203-race-005|description: Shizuku felt doubts about Rui's methods, but out of respect she couldn't voice her feelings. Meanwhile, Rui was also dejected that she and Shizuku weren't clicking, but a conversation with Nagisa gave her a hint and she decides to talk with Shizuku. And so the two clash over their opinions--
data.st-eve-2203-race-006|description: The day of the live. Shizuku can't hide her nerves for a stage that will also surprise the fans. But thanks to Rui's words that practice never betrays you, she felt a little more confident than usual. After the stage ends, a certain change comes to both of their feelings.
data.st-eve-2204-contest-001|description: Despite having a joint practice with LizNoir, Suzu is absorbed in watching DVDs of her beloved Mana. Dragged along by the Tsuki no Tempest members, she starts practicing, but she can't help being bothered by your gaze. What is the meaning behind the gaze directed at Suzu...?
data.st-eve-2204-contest-002|description: Suzu is chosen to represent Hoshimi Production and sing Mana's song on a special program. What's more, the song is "Precious," the one she loves most. Suzu is fully motivated, but as she researches Mana, she steadily loses confidence...
data.st-eve-2204-contest-003|description: Dejected after comparing herself to Mana, Suzu can't get into her rhythm. You explain to Suzu the reason you chose her as the representative. However, those words give Suzu a grave misunderstanding.
data.st-eve-2204-contest-004|description: Mistakenly believing you have feelings for her, Suzu agonizes alone. Kotono and Rio, unable to watch, deny it, but their words don't reach her. Unable to bear being conscious of you any longer, Suzu runs out of the room mid-lesson--
data.st-eve-2204-contest-005|description: Seeing a certain something you left with Rio, Suzu's heart aches. What Suzu saw was proof of your feelings for Mana. "He has no romantic feelings for me." When the misunderstanding is cleared up, what she feels is not only embarrassment--
data.st-eve-2204-contest-006|description: On the day the program airs, Suzu tells you, "If I make the stage a success, I have something important to tell you." Will Suzu be able to sing Mana's song all the way through? And what is this resolve-requiring thing she wants to tell you...?
data.st-eve-2205-race-001|description: The sisters Chisa and Saki each felt impatient watching nearby members succeed. Just then, you bring word to everyone at Hoshimi Production of a live battle tournament limited to two-person units. When you call for volunteers, two of them raise their hands at once.
data.st-eve-2205-race-002|description: Chisa and Saki decide to form a limited unit. They quickly begin lessons, but things don't go well. They enter the tournament with their gears still not meshing, and somehow make it through the first round, but...
data.st-eve-2205-race-002|name:
We Can't
Stay As We Are
data.st-eve-2205-race-003|description: Chisa and Saki keep practicing for the next match, but their gears still don't mesh. With both in a slump, Chisa confides her worries to Nagisa. Nagisa speaks of the regret Kotono left toward her sister, and Chisa resolves to do something.
data.st-eve-2205-race-003|name:
I Don't Want
to Regret Anything
data.st-eve-2205-race-004|description: "You're not sparkling right now, onee-chan." Chisa tells Saki straight to her face what she couldn't say before. Saki clashes back in response. Having confronted each other with their true feelings, the two take a big step forward from a relationship of mutual concession.
data.st-eve-2205-race-004|name:
What We
Truly Want to Do
data.st-eve-2205-race-005|description: Chisa and Saki's relationship changed from one of concession to one of rivalry. To onlookers they may seem to be fighting, but the two themselves are having the time of their lives. Having fought their way to the finals of the live battle tournament, the two--

data.st-eve-2207-contest-001|description: Due to Pret-a-Porter's scandal, IIIX's popularity fell to the ground. Even after transferring to Hoshimi Production, they hadn't been able to work properly since I-UNITY. You approach them about appearing at an idol music festival.
data.st-eve-2207-contest-002|description: Sakura wants to become friends with IIIX, so she suggests a dinner gathering to you. In contrast to the eager Kana, Miho and Fran show resistance. In the end, you have dinner with just Sakura, Kana, and you.
data.st-eve-2207-contest-003|description: The night of the day the dinner was held. Miho and Fran were drinking together at an izakaya. Fran had felt something off about Miho, who'd shown a disgusted look when invited to the dinner. When she asks the reason...
data.st-eve-2207-contest-004|description: The day before the idol music festival. IIIX, visiting for rehearsal, are astonished at the difference in treatment compared to when they belonged to Pret-a-Porter. As Kana begins to suspect harassment over such treatment, the rehearsal is interrupted by rain...
data.st-eve-2207-contest-005|description: The day of the fest. The three take photos on Kana's suggestion that her friendship appeal would be good publicity. They'd worried about the audience turnout due to bad weather, but the venue was overflowing with fans. Welcomed by cheers, IIIX head to their first stage in a while.
data.st-eve-2208-backside-001-limited|descrip: Even on the day off after the live, LizNoir work up a sweat in the studio. The two younger members, exasperated by their stoicism, wish to play together like it's summer but find it hard to bring up. So Kokoro makes a suggestion to the two seniors.

data.st-eve-2209-contest-002|description: TRINITYAiLE meet Miku, projected through hologram technology, and discuss the songs to perform. You tell the three that you'll make a new song celebrating Miku's anniversary. You add that you'd like to leave the lyric writing entirely to TRINITYAiLE.
data.st-eve-2209-contest-003|description: TRINITYAiLE struggle with lyric writing for the first time. They have so much they want to convey and so much feeling they want to give, yet can't put it together well. Miku gives the three advice: don't overthink it; just write your feelings honestly, as they are, and it'll be fine.
data.st-eve-2209-contest-004|description: Miku, having participated in TRINITYAiLE's handshake event. By interacting directly with fans, she thinks she might be able to get closer to them. As Miku searches for ways to express even more gratitude to fans, Rui makes a certain suggestion.
data.st-eve-2209-contest-005|description: On Rui's suggestion, Miku decides to make a song together with TRINITYAiLE. To reflect Miku's honest feelings as well, they resolve to rebuild it from the concept. The magical melody carrying the four's "feelings" soars not only to fans but across the world.

data.st-eve-2402-contest-003|description: Together with Miku, everyone thinks of a surprise for this live. The surprise contents are decided smoothly, but now they end up thinking of ways to liven up winter Hokkaido...
data.st-eve-2402-contest-004|description: Everyone tosses out various ideas to liven up winter Hokkaido. But they hit a dead end, and the members rack their brains. Just then, the idea Miku offers is--
data.st-eve-2402-contest-005|description: Thanks to Ai's idea, Miku and the LizNoir members decide how to liven up Hokkaido. Though time is limited, each struggles with all her might to deliver the best performance, and the day of the live finally arrives.
data.st-eve-2403-race-001|description: SUNNY PEACE, having decided to hold their first nationwide tour. They immediately gather in the meeting room to think about the tour title and DVD bonus footage. As a result, the tour title is decided as "Connecting." The members will travel the country, granting the fans' dreams written in their fan letters.
data.st-eve-2403-race-002|description: In Okinawa and Fukuoka. The members grant fans' dreams on location. They go fishing together and help with a supermarket's promotional calls.
data.st-eve-2403-race-003|description: In Hiroshima and Nagoya. SUNNY PEACE interact with fans and grant dreams. However, in Hiroshima, something cruel awaits Rei...
data.st-eve-2403-race-004|description: In Sendai and Sapporo too, the members grant fans' dreams in the spare time. Fans are energized by the warm feelings of Sakura and the others.
data.st-eve-2403-race-005|description: After the nationwide tour ends. Fan letters again arrive from the fans they interacted with around the country. What was written there were words of gratitude to SUNNY PEACE. Reading the letters, the members once again savor the meaning of the tour title.
data.st-eve-2404-dice-001|description: Kana's videos draw attention overseas, and IIIX receive an offer to appear in a Las Vegas show. Happily heading there, what awaited them was...
data.st-eve-2404-dice-002|description: Shown a run-down stage, Kana gets angry. Fran, who knows how harsh things are overseas, alone gives a realistic opinion. But Miho grows angry at those seemingly resigned words... and the three end up scattered in a land across the sea.
data.st-eve-2404-dice-003|description: Accepting reality while deciding to resist with pride, the three. To overturn everything, for now they join hands once more.
data.st-eve-2404-dice-004|description: IIIX want to make the live a success by any means necessary. They advertise not only through orthodox methods but through means other groups wouldn't even think of.
data.st-eve-2404-dice-005|description: The three achieve great success in Las Vegas. There's also a path of continuing to work overseas, but--
data.st-eve-2405-race-001|description: With the live tour well-received and everything going smoothly, LizNoir receive new work. Apparently, a tie-in with a huge entertainment facility, with a commercial airing nationwide. For further leaps, Rio decides to take the job, but...
data.st-eve-2405-race-002|description: LizNoir tackle the commercial shoot. But the client producer's orders were content far removed from their image up to now.
data.st-eve-2405-race-003|description: The members rack their brains at the producer's orders, which know no bounds. Whether to continue the shoot as is--Aoi decides to talk seriously with Rio.
data.st-eve-2405-race-003|name:
I Think Change
Is Needed Too
data.st-eve-2405-race-004|description: Aoi says that to protect LizNoir's identity, they should back out of this job; Rio says that as professionals, they should see the job through. As opinions split in two, the producer reveals a surprising truth.
data.st-eve-2405-race-005|description: Though each has her own thoughts, the members safely finish the commercial shoot. Later, they take on a live battle with the new song they'd made for the commercial, but--
data.st-eve-2406-contest-001|description: The eve of the decisive battle with Dorikyun. In the dorm's garden, Kotono and Sakura meet. What did Sakura think when Kotono left Tsuki no Tempest? And what feelings do Kotono and the others put into their new song? Under the moonlight, the two exchange words once more.
data.st-eve-2406-contest-001|name: The Eve of the Decisive Battle
data.st-eve-2406-contest-002|description: Behind the scenes of the special training with IIIX, Tsuki no Tempest were working on a new song. In the limited time, they struggle to at least solidify the image of the lyrics, but still have only a vague, hazy image.
data.st-eve-2406-contest-003|description: Tsuki no Tempest, now drawing attention for better or worse after a rematch with Dorikyun is decided. To them, you deliberately propose a live battle. Since it's their first live battle since returning, Kotono feels anxious, but...
data.st-eve-2406-contest-004|description: The people who accepted them. And the two people influenced by Tsuki no Tempest's performance. Finding their own path, moving forward, and such a figure now giving someone courage... Having reexamined what it means to be an idol, Kotono and the others finally grasp the image of the new song.
data.st-eve-2406-contest-004|name:
The Idol
Who Lights the Way
data.st-eve-2406-contest-005|description: SUNNY PEACE and Tsuki no Tempest. The moon, having received the sun's light, shines even brighter, and with a radiance all their own, they face the decisive battle. Toward the top that awaits beyond.
data.st-eve-2407-dice-001|description: SUNNY PEACE, active as BIG4. To them comes an unexpected offer for a deserted-island shoot. Though a harsh shoot, the members are raring to go--only Chisa feels a little anxious.
data.st-eve-2407-dice-002|description: The survival shoot begins. Sakura and the others charge ahead energetically with their natural cheerfulness. Chisa, though bad at entering the sea due to past trauma, vows to try not to be a burden.
data.st-eve-2407-dice-003|description: Out of fear of the sea, Chisa isn't sure she can even ride the escape raft. Still, trying to overcome her past trauma, she decides to enter the sea, but her legs simply freeze up...
data.st-eve-2407-dice-004|description: So as not to be a burden, Chisa keeps holding back without even saying what she wants to do. The one who reaches out a hand to such Chisa was Rei. Pushed on the back by Rei, Chisa realizes the importance of conveying her own feelings...
data.st-eve-2407-dice-004|name:
Chisa, You
Want to Do It, Right?
data.st-eve-2407-dice-005|description: By Chisa's hand, the escape raft is given beautiful decoration. The members, grateful to Chisa, once again invite her to escape together on the raft--
data.st-eve-2407-dice-005|name:
The SUNNY PEACE
Ship, Set Sail!!
data.st-eve-2408-race-001|description: Fran, who had a sudden prank pulled on her, inadvertently exposes an unsightly figure before the camera and vows revenge on Kana and Miho, but...
data.st-eve-2408-race-002|description: The first day of the close-up documentary. Kana and Miho complain about the suddenness, but the moment the cameras roll, the three put on a completely flawless front.
data.st-eve-2408-race-002|name:
Smiling with the Face,
Stepping on Feet
data.st-eve-2408-race-003|description: Because it's a close-up documentary, you think even IIIX will show flaws, and hit upon a certain plan. To make them unite, a common goal should do the trick.
data.st-eve-2408-race-004|description: To make a new song, IIIX stay at a luxury hotel. Of course, there's no way the three work on it harmoniously...
data.st-eve-2408-race-004|name:
United as One?
Making a New Song
data.st-eve-2408-race-005|description: Unknown to your worry, the three of IIIX were moving entirely according to plan. They beautifully complete the new song and charge toward the top.
data.st-eve-2409-marathon-raid-001|descriptio: TRINITYAiLE are all excited about the anime "Pretty★Angel." You arrive there and tell them an offer has come for a 2.5D stage adaptation of "PriEn." Practice under Yu begins at once for the performance, but...?
data.st-eve-2409-marathon-raid-002|descriptio: On a morning program, TRINITYAiLE promote the "PriEn" stage. Thanks to Yu they make a satisfying appeal, and Rui and Sumire are impressed--but Yu's acting in the following charades game is incomprehensible...!?
data.st-eve-2409-marathon-raid-003|descriptio: On the first day of "PriEn" stage rehearsals, Yu begins acting full of confidence. But the director's expression grows darker and darker... Yu is bewildered as her acting receives an evaluation she never expected.
data.st-eve-2409-marathon-raid-003|name:
Daughter of the
Great Actress, Suzumura Kumiko
data.st-eve-2409-marathon-raid-004|descriptio: Yu undergoes intense training for the stage, but the director confronts her with the harsh reality of a cast change. Having managed to secure a one-week grace period, Yu decides to go to her mother, the great actress Suzumura Kumiko--
data.st-eve-2409-marathon-raid-005|descriptio: Thanks to intense training with the great actress Suzumura Kumiko, Yu somehow avoids being dropped from the cast. On the contrary, Yu's acting, which seems to have grasped something, begins to show a great change...?
data.st-eve-2410-dice-001|description: Having overcome hardships and both becoming BIG4, SUNNY PEACE and Tsuki no Tempest. After the exhibition match, the promise exchanged at the sea in Hoshimi City finally starts moving.
data.st-eve-2410-dice-001|name:
The Promise
We Made That Day
data.st-eve-2410-dice-002|description: A collab with Sea Paradise is decided, and the members get excited. Sea Paradise is also the place where they held their triumphant live after the NEXT VENUS Grand Prix, and the members discuss memories of that time and what they want to do in this collab.
data.st-eve-2410-dice-003|description: A collab between Hoshimi Production and Sea Paradise had been held before. Some years ago, you, Mana, and Haruko had visited Sea Paradise. At that time there was not only a live but also a handshake event--
data.st-eve-2410-dice-004|description: Hearing about Mana, Kotono is all the more fired up for the collab. Then, making a certain suggestion to you, she visits Sea Paradise with the members--
data.st-eve-2410-dice-004|name:
To the People
of Hoshimi City
data.st-eve-2410-dice-005|description: The day of the live. With the appearance of a big-name guest too, Sakura and the members brim endlessly with motivation. And at last, all ten stand on the Sea Paradise stage.
data.st-eve-2411-race-001|description: It's decided that Hoshimi Production and a confectionery company will jointly hold the "Hoshimi Friend Fest," and you ask Kokoro and Kana to form a new unit and enter the "Two-as-One Best-Buddy Unit Contest" within it. But one word leads to another, and the two quarrel, saying "I'll never form a unit with you"...?
data.st-eve-2411-race-002|description: With interests aligned, Kokoro and Kana finally decide to enter the fest. To keep their actually-poor relationship from being found out, they hold a strategy meeting for the live broadcast unveiling their new unit. However, Kokoro seems less than cooperative...
data.st-eve-2411-race-002|name:
Best Friends More Real
Than the Real Thing
data.st-eve-2411-race-003|description: After the live broadcast ends, Kokoro and Kana get into a huge fight because they lost badly at a game. Kana, told by Mei and Shizuku who were present that she went too far, ends up going to Kokoro's school for the forgotten item. There, there was an unexpected side of Kokoro--
data.st-eve-2411-race-004|description: Having made up, Kokoro and Kana announce the unit's concept on a live stream. Monopolizing the SNS trends and cheerfully talking about their friendship appeal, someone was listening from the shadows...?
data.st-eve-2411-race-005|description: The two gradually deepen their bond--practicing dance together, Kana teaching Kokoro her studies. And on the day of the "Hoshimi Friend Fest," Kokoro and Kana's new unit deliver a perfectly synchronized back-and-forth.
data.st-eve-2412-contest-001|description: "Pajapa!" are to appear at a Christmas event in a town of wooden buildings. But no sooner do they arrive than Suzu gets lost. Where she ends up is in front of a certain shop--
data.st-eve-2412-contest-001|name:
I Knew at a Glance
You Were
No Ordinary Person
data.st-eve-2412-contest-002|description: The Pajapa! members end up getting to know Cocoa and Chino, who work at the Rabbit House cafe. While having coffee made for them and latte art drawn, they deepen their friendship.
data.st-eve-2412-contest-003|description: Due to an incident, the members end up staying overnight at the Rabbit House cafe. Adding Cocoa and Chino, everyone holds a pajama party. And the next day, the members decide to repay them for letting them stay--
data.st-eve-2412-contest-004|description: From Kokoro's flash of inspiration, everyone decides to prepare a big surprise at the Christmas event. While tutoring Cocoa and Chino, they stack up practice for the big day.
data.st-eve-2412-contest-004|name:
The Surprise Is
a Holy Night
Special Guest
data.st-eve-2412-contest-005|description: The day of the Christmas event. Pajapa! stand on stage and bring smiles to the gathered crowd with song and performance. And at last, the surprise guest appears--
data.st-eve-2412-contest-005|name:
If You Are
by My Side
data.st-eve-2501-race-001|description: TRINITYAiLE, aiming to join BIG4, practiced day and night. But because Sumire is still a middle schooler, Rui and Yu often showed care to keep her from overdoing it. Just then, an offer arrives for a TV program to be broadcast live during New Year--
data.st-eve-2501-race-002|description: The day of the live broadcast. TRINITYAiLE serve as MCs and each also take on a challenge segment. The one Rui takes on is "Let's Give TRINITYAiLE Wings." It was to fly farther and longer in a human-powered aircraft.
data.st-eve-2501-race-003|description: Following Rui's challenge, Yu's super-spicy challenge also begins. Each achieves results in her own way, Rui and Yu. And at last, Sumire's marathon challenge begins. Sumire rouses herself to show her strength to Rui and the others, but--
data.st-eve-2501-race-004|description: Seeing Sumire's accident, Rui and Yu worry in the studio. They manage to decide to wait in trust, but Sumire too was holding her own anxiety alone. The one who rushes to that spot was--
data.st-eve-2501-race-005|description: Just before the program ends. Rui and Yu keep waiting, believing in Sumire. They think of ways to stall, but the ending finally comes. Meanwhile, Sumire uses up her remaining strength--
data.st-eve-2502-marathon-raid-001|descriptio: SUNNY PEACE are to appear in a Valentine's TV commercial. Furthermore, an event related to it is also decided to be held. The members immediately hold a planning meeting to discuss the event contents.
data.st-eve-2502-marathon-raid-002|descriptio: You notice that the SUNNY PEACE members are secretly preparing handmade chocolate. Being idols, you can't help but worry about who they'll give it to...
data.st-eve-2502-marathon-raid-003|descriptio: The day of Valentine's. You can't help but wonder who the members intend to give chocolate to. Meanwhile, it seems the members had various things happen at school--
data.st-eve-2502-marathon-raid-004|descriptio: The Valentine's event by SUNNY PEACE finally begins. The members sing their songs in a medley, do the segments prepared for the day, and give lots of presents to the gathered fans.
data.st-eve-2502-marathon-raid-005|descriptio: The Valentine's event reaches its climax. A new song is performed by SUNNY PEACE. And at last, you too come to learn who the members had prepared chocolate for--
data.st-eve-2503-dice-001|description: Rei, Chisa, Mei, and Saki, who attend Prefectural North High, are one day summoned by Suzumiya Haruhi. Adding Asahina Mikuru and Nagato Yuki too, they're told to stand on a festival stage together as the SOS Brigade, but...
data.st-eve-2503-dice-002|description: Saki and the others thought of themselves as perfectly ordinary people, but Nagato Yuki and Asahina Mikuru tell them a shocking fact. The four begin taking action to resolve the situation.
data.st-eve-2503-dice-002|name:
SUNNY PEACE &
Tsuki no Tempest, Shocked
data.st-eve-2503-dice-003|description: The day of the festival. The members manage to liven up the venue greatly as the SOS Brigade. However, though the seven-person live was a great success, for some reason they can't return to their original world--
data.st-eve-2503-dice-003|name:
I Have No Interest
in a Mere
Manager
data.st-eve-2504-marathon-raid-001|descriptio: The 2.5D stage "Pretty★Angel," starring TRINITYAiLE. Shizuku and the others, moved by its quality, ask you to let them try stage work too, but--
data.st-eve-2504-marathon-raid-002|descriptio: Formed by five--Shizuku, Suzu, Sakura, Kotono, and Yu--'Troupe★Mi.' First they gather to exchange opinions on what kind of stage, what kind of story, what casting, and so on.
data.st-eve-2504-marathon-raid-003|descriptio: The play is decided as "Alice in Wonderland." Next comes deciding the cast, but both Shizuku and Suzu won't yield, saying they want to play the lead. The members discuss and decide to settle the lead by audition, but--
data.st-eve-2504-marathon-raid-004|descriptio: The day of the stage. Centered on Shizuku and Suzu, a fun, ingenious stage opens. You watch each one's performance from the wings, impressed by Yu's bold script arrangement.
data.st-eve-2504-marathon-raid-005|descriptio: At last the Queen of Hearts appears, and Alice-Shizuku and Alice-Suzu are driven to the wall. On stage, the "Troupe★Mi" members perform with all their might while enjoying themselves, and the story heads toward its climax.
data.st-eve-2504-marathon-raid-005|name:
And They Lived
Happily Ever After
data.st-eve-2507-free-001|description: IIIX are to appear at a famous music festival held in America. Besides the festival appearance, the three will stay in America for a while to pitch various things over there...
data.st-eve-2507-free-002|description: IIIX appear on an American live broadcast program. After the program ends, Kana gets a call from an unexpected person. Kana arranges not just a phone call but a meeting--
data.st-eve-2507-free-003|description: Kana finally reunites with the father she had always wanted to find. While eager to show her father her good side, it seems Fran also got a call from someone--
data.st-eve-2507-free-004|description: Fran is overjoyed that a big name influential enough to sponsor the fest might support her brand. Meanwhile, Miho, reuniting with an old acquaintance, is showered with harsh words--
data.st-eve-2507-free-005|description: Kana suddenly announces she'll disband IIIX. Fran seems able to give her brand a fresh start. Miho is crushed over her precious best friend. The answer the three arrive at is--
data.st-eve-2507-race-001|description: A nationwide tour by all the idols of Hoshimi Production. Such a dream finally comes true. The members immediately split into a team to prepare costumes for the tour and a team to prepare new songs and start preparations.
data.st-eve-2507-race-002|description: Ai, chosen to serve as leader of the new song's production. At first she was stiff with nerves, but she summons courage and conveys her own opinion--
data.st-eve-2507-race-003|description: The Hoshimi Production nationwide tour finally begins. However, thinking it a great chance to interact across group boundaries, they decide to assign hotel rooms by lottery--
data.st-eve-2507-race-004|description: The idols travel the country: Aichi performance, Fukuoka performance, Miyagi performance. They appear on local TV programs, go out to enjoy local gourmet, spending days unique to a tour.
data.st-eve-2507-race-005|description: At last, the tour's final day, the Tokyo performance, begins. The Hoshimi Production idols shine on stage like the stars floating in the night sky and deliver their gratitude to everyone.
data.st-eve-2507-race-005|name:
The World's Most
Beautiful Starry Sky
data.st-eve-2508-free-001|description: Upon arriving in America, you are suddenly told of IIIX's "disbandment." Though you don't understand the situation, you approach Fran, the center, to try to stop the disbandment.
data.st-eve-2508-free-002|description: In exchange for the investment, fran is asked to work as IIIX and to promote through Live battles. She hurries to persuade miho in order to stop the disbandment, but--
data.st-eve-2508-free-003|description: Whatever form it took, fran managed to talk with miho. Hearing that she will speak with kana next, you, who have watched the two always fighting, grow worried, but--
data.st-eve-2508-free-004|description: The day of the festival finally arrives. But, of all things, only fran is at the venue. As you despair, thinking the persuasion ultimately failed, the dressing room door opens--
data.st-eve-2508-free-005|description: fran, kana, and miho. Reunited for absolute victory, the three take up the fight to become genuine top idols.
data.st-eve-2509-contest-001|description: Tsuki no Tempest, blessed with work, were spending a fulfilling summer. But as summer break was about to end, something came to light. Astonishingly, aside from Saki, not a single one of them had finished their summer homework.
data.st-eve-2509-contest-001|name:
A Training Camp
to Conquer Homework
data.st-eve-2509-contest-002|description: Having finished their summer homework, the members went out to play. To everyone, Saki hands out the tickets she received from you. They turned out to be live tickets for that hugely popular virtual singer, Hatsune Miku.
data.st-eve-2509-contest-002|name:
The Virtual
Singer Who
Captivates the World
data.st-eve-2509-contest-003|description: At Miku's request, Tsuki no Tempest end up making a guest appearance at a live. To deepen their friendship for the live, Saki and the others and Miku decide to play together.
data.st-eve-2509-contest-004|description: Saki and the others fully enjoyed summer together. However, Miku had one question. "Why does everyone feel lonely when summer ends?" To answer that question, Saki and the others--
data.st-eve-2509-contest-005|description: At last, the day of the live. Tsuki no Tempest and Miku form a huddle and pump themselves up. The special new song prepared for this day. The theme of the song performed on this precious anniversary is that very thing Miku found mysterious--
data.st-eve-2510-marathon-raid-001|descriptio: Yu, having become student council president of Tsukide High School, kept working to improve the school even amid her busy life as a current idol. Rui, too, supported Yu like that day by day. Just then, a certain event draws near--
data.st-eve-2510-marathon-raid-002|descriptio: Kotono and Nagisa spend busy days as members of Tsuki no Tempest. But perhaps because she has not been able to attend school much, Kotono feels a distance from her classmates. Just then, thinking a certain event will be a good chance--
data.st-eve-2510-marathon-raid-003|descriptio: Yu is set to do a musical as her class's cultural festival attraction. Likewise, in the classes of Aoi and Ai, who attend Tsukide Academy, various attractions seem to be planned--
data.st-eve-2510-marathon-raid-004|descriptio: The day of the school festival. Kotono and Nagisa's class runs a cat-eared maid cafe as originally planned. What is more, since there were requests, they are also set to hold a live in the gymnasium--
data.st-eve-2510-marathon-raid-004|name:
Open for Business:
The Cat-Eared
Maid Cafe
data.st-eve-2510-marathon-raid-005|descriptio: Kotono and Nagisa came to play at Tsukide High School's cultural festival. But they are suddenly summoned over the PA, and, of all things, Yu and Rui ask them for a favor. According to them, they seem to be short on actors for the musical--
data.st-eve-2510-marathon-raid-005|name:
Curtain Up: Sister
vs. Cat-Eared
Demon Maid
data.st-eve-2511-race-001|description: LizNoir have been spending busy days since becoming BIG4. As additional shows on their overseas tour are decided, Aoi decides to take on a new challenge for LizNoir.
data.st-eve-2511-race-001|name:
I Want You
to Let Me
Take Charge
data.st-eve-2511-race-002|description: The four of LizNoir arrive in America. They end up able to live again in the memorable room where they once stayed, but... amid that, Aoi kept agonizing over a new song.
data.st-eve-2511-race-003|description: Perhaps because she relaxed in the hot spring, Aoi comes up with all sorts of ideas. However, though ideas gush out like water, once she actually starts making something it seems difficult--
data.st-eve-2511-race-004|description: Aoi finds a new path in the fusion of LizNoir and samba. With help from Rio and the others, and having gained an insight, Aoi starts creating with the aim of the best choreography and song.
data.st-eve-2511-race-005|description: The first day of the overseas tour's additional shows. Having splendidly completed the new song, Aoi and the others ease each other's nerves and take the stage. And before the American fans who came to greet them, they give a wonderful performance.
data.st-eve-2511-race-005|name:
The Festival
Is About to
Begin
data.st-eve-2512-dice-001|description: Rio, Rui, Rei, Kokoro, and Sumire--five in all--stack up practice for the Christmas event. But just then, something suddenly falls from the sky--
data.st-eve-2512-dice-002|description: Until a way home is found, Lala and the others end up living together in the dorm. However, various troubles arise because of these girls, who are so mysterious and unique--
data.st-eve-2512-dice-003|description: Lala and the others finally find a way home. The method, of all things, converts the heat and feelings generated by a live into energy and collects it. To do that, it seems they need to modify their costumes--
data.st-eve-2601-race-001|description: It is decided to open IIIX's official video channel on social media. After several meetings, they end up each filming their off-duty selves and making videos, but--
data.st-eve-2601-race-002|description: Learning that miho bought a car, kana proposes filming a drive video. By the flow of things, her precious car ends up being driven by fran and kana, and though miho is displeased, kana and the others scheme further to liven up the video--
data.st-eve-2601-race-003|description: IIIX come up with various plans and film various videos. But with only three days left until the channel opens, they have not filmed any decent videos. Amid that, miho proposes something--
data.st-eve-2601-race-004|description: On miho's suggestion, IIIX decide to prepare a home game console and film gameplay videos. The close-knit trio end up playing something called a "Friendship-Destroying Game," but--
data.st-eve-2601-race-004|name:
The Close-Knit Trio
and the Friendship-
Destroying Game
data.st-eve-2601-race-005|description: The day the channel opens. At the New Year's countdown live, IIIX simultaneously livestream the live footage. The subscriber count grows safely, and they greet the new year with bright feelings, but--
data.st-eve-2602-dice-001|description: Even after becoming BIG4, Tsuki no Tempest keep taking on further challenges. With Kotono and Suzu as dual centers, their expression is growing more refined, and amid that, Kotono proposes something.
data.st-eve-2602-dice-002|description: They will decide the center from among the five. Nagisa, who has watched Kotono and Suzu up close until now, felt the weight of the word "center." Kotono notices Nagisa, gazing up at the moon alone--
data.st-eve-2602-dice-003|description: As rivals vying for the center and as comrades sharing the same goal, Nagisa, Saki, and Mei polish their performance. And at last, the day the center is announced arrives--
data.st-eve-2602-dice-004|description: With Nagisa chosen as the center of the new song, the other members renew their feelings as well. Each fully does what she can, and the five unite their hearts for the new song.
data.st-eve-2602-dice-005|description: At last, the day of the live. Nagisa is nervous, but Kotono, her best friend and the one with the most experience as center, covers for her. Amid that, Nagisa has prepared a certain plan--
data.st-eve-2603-race-001|description: To coincide with Mana's birthday, Kotono completes the lyrics for "With your songs," an answer song to "song for you." However, the composition is not progressing as she would like--
data.st-eve-2603-race-002|description: Kotono ends up creating the melody in cooperation with Suzu. While talking about memories with Mana, since both have experience with piano, they decide to try playing--
data.st-eve-2603-race-003|description: At a place of memories, Kotono talks about the necklace she gave Mana for her birthday. Nagase Mana as an idol, Nagase Mana as a sister... Suzu and Kotono look back on the Nagase Mana each of them knows.
data.st-eve-2603-race-004|description: Kotono once avoided learning about Nagase Mana as an idol. But she decides to hear about Mana anew from Haruko, Rio, and Sakura, who shares the same heart.
